newsitem.title: UK: LME copper comes off highs, loses grip on $2,200.
newsitem.headline: LME copper comes off highs, loses grip on $2,200.

text.p: COPPER - Fails to hold above $2,200 level on profit-taking, but still ends PM kerb firmer. Boosted by stock drop, wider spread.
ALUMINIUM - Ends marginally easier, near day's lows after early push above $1,560. NICKEL - Finishes near highs.
LEAD - Weakens, just at $700. ZINC - Unchanged.
TIN - Weaker, drops below $5,800. ALLOY - Steady.
